title: Quiz
description: Shape of window.QUIZ_CONFIG in quiz.js. Questions in window.QUIZ_QUESTIONS in questions.js use the question definition below. Every quiz uses this same shape.

id.description: Short id for this exam. Used only as a name.

storageKey.description: Browser storage key. Keep it stable so saved answers are not wiped. Use a different key for each exam.

examMinutes.description: Default Mock Exam time limit in whole minutes. Verify the certification's official guide before setting it. Learners can choose a custom limit before starting.

copy.description: Optional replacements for button and label text. Keys match the library defaults.

sections.description: Order of this array is the order on the home page.

lead.description: Highlight this rank on the home page.

ordered.description: Practice this rank in study-group order, then question id.

groups.description: Study groups. Order is the study order for a focus marked ordered.

oneOf.description: A paragraph of the question, explanation, or notes.

code.description: Source code. An array of lines is easier to edit than one string.

section.description: Must match a section id in quiz.js.

focus.description: Must match a focus id in quiz.js.

group.description: Must match a group id in quiz.js.

choices.description: First item is A, second is B, and so on.

answer.description: "A" or "A,C". With acceptAny, any one of the letters is correct. An ungraded question without a verified answer may use an empty string.

corrected.description: True only when the original mock answer key is wrong. Do not flag wording-only repairs, unchanged answer sets, or acceptAny additions that still accept the printed answer.

repaired.description: True for a scored question with a verified minimal fix, externally recovered missing content, or expanded accepted alternatives while its original answer remains accepted. Recovery requires documented matching evidence. Never invent scenario assumptions or replace option meanings to force a key. Excludes explanation-only edits, formatting, Corrected and Not scored.

repair.description: Explain the exact edit, verified recovery or accepted-answer change and its reason. Shown in Question changes above exact comparisons. Partial online recoveries may show this while remaining Not scored; references use original mock letters.

repairNotes.description: Optional recovery references and source-review details shown only in Question changes, separate from Full explanation study notes.

printed.description: Letters printed in the original mock. Retain for source history even when corrected is absent. Not scored feedback displays these as an unverified reference, never as the graded answer.

source.description: Original question content retained when an answer or wording is corrected.

review.description: Per-question source review decision. Full decisions remain in question data; the static notice summarizes only current Corrected, Repaired and Not scored questions.

optionAudit.description: Online comparison of option text and count, independently of the published answer key. Explicitly record reordered/damaged variants and unavailable material.

reassessment.description: Individual best-answer and source-fidelity reassessment of a previously Not scored or Repaired question.

recovery.description: Online search audit for a previously Not scored item. Candidates are comparison evidence, not authoritative answer keys.

wrong.description: One sentence for each incorrect letter.
